# Video script: The five-view sweep

> Verified content.

Unit D1 | Target length: 8 min

| # | Shot | Narration | Claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Presenter to camera | You do not have to name the lesion. You have to notice that the heart is not normal. Five planes, one sweep. | - |
| 2 | Machine console and screen | Cardiac preset. Narrow the sector. One focal zone at the heart. Zoom until the heart fills a third to a half of the screen. | IS23-014, IS23-015 |
| 3 | Diagram: fetus with five stacked planes | From the upper abdomen towards the head: abdomen, four chambers, left outflow, right outflow with three vessels, three vessels and trachea. | IS23-023 |
| 4 | Split screen: hand on abdomen / ultrasound screen | Work out fetal left and right first. Abdomen: stomach left, aorta left of the spine, vena cava right. | IS23-021, IS23-024 |
| 5 | Four-chamber clip with overlay of thorax outline and axis line | A third of the chest. Mostly on the left. Axis forty-five degrees, give or take twenty. Rate one-twenty to one-sixty, regular. | IS23-026, IS23-028, IS23-033 |
| 6 | Four-chamber clip, labels appearing one by one | Two atria the same size, flap in the left. Two ventricles the same size, moderator band on the right. Septum intact from apex to crux. Two valves, the tricuspid a little nearer the apex. | IS23-038, IS23-042, IS23-043, IS23-044, IS23-047 |
| 7 | Split screen: small tilt of the hand / LVOT clip | Slide up. A vessel from the left ventricle, its wall continuous with the septum. It does not divide. | IS23-052, IS23-059 |
| 8 | RVOT and three-vessel clip with overlay | Up again. A vessel from the right ventricle crosses in front and divides. Three vessels in a line, big to small, left to right. | IS23-052, IS23-065, IS23-066 |
| 9 | Three-vessel-and-trachea clip, grey-scale then colour | Last plane. Two arches, both left of the trachea, meeting in a V. Colour shows both flowing the same way. | IS23-069, IS23-074 |
| 10 | Presenter | If any plane fails its criteria, the fetus needs a fetal echocardiogram. | IS23-078 |
